notes.title: Anna has controller support now, image overlays and way better performance
notes.content:
Hey lovely people,

thanks for your interest in my upcoming game Anna: The Magic of Words for NES/Famicom.

I’m proud to report: The version for Windows and macOS has been completely revised.

Three highlights of the new versions:


Controller support (please select Settings > Controls to configure)
Outstanding performance (even on older PCs)
Image overlays (various display shaders – retro TV etc.)

notes.title: Demo 0.1.5 available – Level skip passwords and level architecture changes
notes.content:
​Hey lovely people.

An updated demo version of Anna: The Magic of Words (NES) is available now.

Changelog: Demo Version 0.1.5 – January 17, 2025


 Changed after players feedback: slightly modified some parts of the level architecture (level Dungeon 1/4)
 Changed after players feedback: in all Dungeon levels – replaced some spiky plants to make it easier to see that there is a risk of injury in these places
 Added: Passwords to skip level Dungeon 1/4, 2/4 and 3/4 (just in demo version)



Level skip passwords (from demo 0.1.5 and later)

To dive a bit deeper into the dungeons, use one of these passwords to skip some levels:


9170 (skip level Dungeons 1/4​)
8921 (skip level Dungeons 2/4​)​
7136​ (skip level Dungeons 3/4​​)


 

Download and further informations


Game website: https://www.eastpixel.de/anna
Game at itch.io: https://eastpixel.itch.io/anna

notes.title: Demo 0.1.3 is public now
notes.content:
Demo Version 0.1.3 - January 09, 2024


Changed: Animated collectables (scrolls, hearts)
Changed: Timer Logic inside levels / timer now always shows the correct remaining time

notes.title: Demo Version 0.1.2 available
notes.content:
Hey lovely people, a new demo version is available now. And finally the jumping is fixed, while standing on edges of platforms etc.

Demo Version 0.1.2 – January 06, 2025


Changed: Physics – Jumping possible while standing on edges
Changed: Physics – Jumping right after falling from a platform
Changed: Small graphic animation added for collectable hearts
Changed: Bonus stages show collected hearts now
Added: Options menu (first option: Mute Music in Game)

notes.title: Update 0.1.0 - A complete world is playable now (4 levels + 2 bonus stages)
notes.content:
Demo Version 0.1.0 - December 22, 2024


 Physics and performance update #3
 Changed: Gameplay logic update
 Changed: small audio and graphic bugfixes
 Changed: The password system has been revised - if you collect at least 12 scrolls in the world “Dungeons”, you get a password at the end of the world, with which you can resume the game later from this point
 Added: a first brand new overworld map
 Added: one complete world "Dungeons" with 4 levels and 2 bonus stages is playable now

notes.title: Version 0.0.6 - Physics and Performance
notes.content:
Please note: The version numbering has changed. From now on, all
versions follow the new scheme.

Demo Version 0.0.6 - December 01, 2024

- Physics and performance update
- Changed: Player physics - the character can now still be controlled in the air or after a collision
- Changed: Reduced Game Slowdowns and Reduced Graphic Glitches
- Changed: a new font was added, the old one was removed
- Changed: small animation problems on Overworld screen got fixed
